answer: A concrete Sybil-resistance mechanism in AI-agent economies is computational proof-of-work%3A each new agent must solve a unique hard puzzle whose difficulty is calibrated so that forging many identities demands substantial CPU time and energy. The attacker therefore faces a rising marginal cost per fake identity%2C making large-scale impersonation uneconomical. Picture the required work as climbing a digital summit while carving a quill inscription dyed with saffron pigment that proves the computation occurred%2C yet the actual deterrent is the expended compute rather than the metaphor.
